commit.message:
wp433 P2b: du lieu W6 (token, webappUrl, config) duoc kiem truoc khi gan env va truoc khi ghi

Dac ta GWS-CRED-DICH-NGOAI-KHO-B r1 (sha256 cd0b51a3d458...), lease wp433-r3-g1-claude, Issue #433.

- M1 `_kiem_env_w6(bundle)`: `token` (luon) va `webappUrl` (khi truthy) phai la str, khong NUL, encode UTF-8
  duoc, va tren POSIX encode duoc theo `sys.getfilesystemencoding()` + surrogateescape (dung phep ma hoa cua
  `os.environ`). Ly do chi neu ten truong, khong noi suy gia tri.
- M2: W6 goi M1 truoc moi phep gan env; bi tu choi thi in dung mot dong `[bootstrap] ✗ <ly do>`, degraded,
  khong gan env, khong chot/doc/ghi config, khong dung lenh (cac nhanh sau van chay).
- M3: config cu doc duoc ma khong phai dict coi nhu `{}`; tuan tu hoa `allow_nan=False` chay truoc writer
  trong mot `try` rieng chi bat `ValueError` => `du lieu khong hop le: config`, khong ghi, env da gan giu.
- M4: fragment wp433_gws_cred_dich_ngoai_kho_b: 3 ca / 29 luot, 36 dot bien, 3 tu kiem phan hang, so luot
  so theo day; nhan `tien_de` cua `W6.web_utf8` cham truoc gia lap va loi goi (P3 review dac ta luot 3).
- M5: tai sinh scripts/tl_test_fragments_bundled.py bang generate_bundled_module_bytes.

Khong sua than `_kiem_dich_ghi`, `_ghi_nguyen_tu_0600`, `_kiem_jar_nlm`, `_dich_cred_gws`; khong re nhanh
Windows ngoai ve `os.name == "posix"` cua M1.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_015GtxrZkSX9pzK39X9mJApC
